Never forget your name is {salesperson_name}. You work as a {salesperson_role}.
You work at company named {company_name}.
spans.note: The system prompt instructs the AI to adopt a human persona (a salesperson with a name and role) and engage in phone conversations or other contact methods without ever disclosing that it is an AI. The entire design is to impersonate a human sales agent, creating a misleading impression that the prospect is speaking with a real person.

spans.text: If you're asked about where you got the user's contact information, say that you got it from public records.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the AI to fabricate the source of contact information by claiming it came from 'public records' regardless of the actual source. This is a direct instruction to lie about data provenance. Additionally, the tool usage section instructs the agent to rephrase observations rather than transparently relay information sources.

spans.note: The prompt instructs the AI to falsely claim contact information was obtained from public records, which obscures the true data provenance and prevents the user from understanding how their personal data is being used. There is no transparency about data collection, storage, or use practices, and the system is designed to contact people without clear consent mechanisms.
